env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A block segment lambda of a group stage takes every statement form the
# checker accepts, natively and in the ejected module: select, switch with
# an init, labeled and goto jumps, defer, a function literal with ?, a
# nested stage, a nested block lambda, a switch expression, ??,
# interpolation, a type switch, and a range over an integer.
# chain_stage_block_forms.lgo prints one ok line per form.
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_block_forms.lgo a/main.lgo

cd a
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_block_forms.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
! exists out/main.lgo
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_block_forms.out
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds and runs with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_block_forms.out
cd ../..

-- a/go.mod --
module example.com/chainstageblockforms

go 1.27
